abilities.name: Modern Recall
abilities.description: You can recall one fact from your old world's schooling, like a recipe, formula or map, clearly enough to use it here.
abilities.cost: The memory pushes out one memory of this world

growth.grows: how detailed and how specialised the knowledge

abilities.name: Translation Gift
abilities.description: You can read and speak any language you hear spoken for a full minute, but only plainly.
abilities.cost: Idioms and poetry come through as nonsense

growth.grows: how fluent and how quickly you pick it up

abilities.name: Inventory Pocket
abilities.description: Store one small object in a space only you can reach, and draw it out again with a thought.
abilities.cost: Living things cannot go in; the pocket holds only one thing

growth.grows: how many objects and how large

abilities.name: Appraisal Glance
abilities.description: Look at an item for a few seconds to see its name and one property in a small window.
abilities.cost: Eyes ache after a dozen appraisals

growth.grows: how many properties and how rare an item

abilities.name: Outsider's Eye
abilities.description: Spot a custom or rule of this world that would get a stranger hurt, before you break it.
abilities.cost: Only after you have spent a day among the people

growth.grows: how subtle a custom you notice

abilities.name: Kitchen Revolution
abilities.description: You can cook a simple dish from your old world with local ingredients and anyone who tastes it wants more.
abilities.cost: Needs a kitchen and an afternoon; locals get suspicious of the new food

growth.grows: how complex a dish and how eager the eaters

abilities.name: Goddess's Small Favor
abilities.description: Pray for help when lost and a faint light points you to the nearest safe shelter.
abilities.cost: The goddess asks a small task in return

growth.grows: how big a favor and how specific the guidance

abilities.name: Skill Copy
abilities.description: Watch someone use a skill three times and you can copy it at a clumsy, beginner level.
abilities.cost: The copy fades in a week unless you practice it

growth.grows: how well you copy and how long it lasts

abilities.name: Hero's Resolve
abilities.description: When you are protecting someone weaker, you can keep standing through pain that would drop you otherwise.
abilities.cost: You collapse once they are safe

growth.grows: how much pain you can stand through

abilities.name: Number Sense
abilities.description: You can count coins, crowds or supplies at a glance and know the exact number.
abilities.cost: Only what you can see all of at once

growth.grows: how large a number at a glance

abilities.name: Map Overlay
abilities.description: Close your eyes and see a rough map of every place you have walked in this world.

growth.grows: how detailed the map and whether it shows places you heard of

abilities.name: Status Hide
abilities.description: When someone appraises you, you can show them a weaker, plainer version of your abilities.
abilities.cost: Hiding takes focus; you cannot fight while doing it

growth.grows: how strong an appraiser it fools
